capabilities: Sync Canvas LMS courses, modules, assignments, discussions, grades, and calendars into Markdown notes
Receive course data from a companion browser extension over localhost without an API token
Generate typed YAML frontmatter, wikilinks, callouts, and hub notes (Announcements.md, Grades.md, Calendar.md)
Download embedded images, attachments, and course documents with size and extension filters
Schedule background resyncs at configurable intervals and probe token permissions via diagnostics
disambiguation: Unrelated to Obsidian's Canvas whiteboard feature; it syncs course data from the Canvas LMS education platform.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The companion browser extension is maintained in a separate repository and installed from the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons. Tokens are stored locally in data.json; the local listener runs only when toggled on. Installation via BRAT is supported for beta releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Canvas LMS course content, deadlines, grades, and files into a vault as organized notes.

relations.evidence: fully compatible with Obsidian Dataview, Tasks, and Canvas cards
fully compatible with Obsidian Dataview, Tasks, and Canvas cards
The browser extension source code, pre-packaged .zip release files, and store deployment pipelines are maintained in a dedicated repository

requires.name: Canvas API access token (for direct REST API mode)
Companion browser extension (for zero-token bridge mode)

summary: Syncs Canvas LMS courses, assignments, discussions, grades, and calendars into the vault as structured Markdown notes via REST API or a browser extension bridge.
